Server-Side Request Forgery - Protocol Smuggling

SSRF attack using protocol smuggling to bypass URL validation.
Application validates URL scheme but doesn't normalize protocols properly.

Smuggling technique:
- Input validation: checks for http/https
- Bypass: gopher://internal-host, dict://service:port, sftp://path

Attack payload: gopher://redis-cache.internal:6379/_flushdb
